data.title: 瑕光 · 合照的相框
data.description: 相框的背板不太好扣，她试了两次才合上。照片摆到桌面后，她满意地笑了。
data.camera: 中近景，相框与双手清晰
data.promptProse: Seated at a polished side table in a warm family living room, Blemishine smiles tenderly as she fastens the backing of an engraved wooden picture frame holding a cherished family portrait. Soft ambient lamp glow reflects off framed photographs on the wall behind her, illuminating cozy knit blankets, a sleeping house cat on the sofa, and homey evening tranquility.
data.animaCaption: Seated at a living room side table, she smiles tenderly while fitting a cherished family photograph into an engraved wooden frame. Soft lamp glow warms the cozy room, knit blankets, and the sleeping cat on the sofa behind her.
